# ADR-NNN — Decision title

Record owner, date/revision, related requirements/packages and the decision register entry. Origin and disposition use the decision register's definitions; copying this template does not accept a decision.

## Context and deadline

Describe the concrete problem, constraints, decision needed now and latest safe checkpoint. Explain what can proceed provisionally and under which restrictions.

## Options and evidence

Compare viable options against the same criteria: behavior, ownership, security, operability, compatibility, cost and delivery impact. Link actual experiments or primary sources; label assumptions and missing evidence.

## Decision

State the selected or proposed option, scope, rationale and accountable acceptance. Keep direction separate from unverified implementation details.

## Consequences and validation

Describe responsibilities, trade-offs, risks, migration/exit implications and required acceptance checks. Identify affected services, contracts, packages and support combinations.

## Revisit conditions

Identify what would invalidate the decision, who reviews it and what evidence is needed. Preserve this record when superseded and link its replacement.
